The [[Ee]] of [[Trilos]] used an '''icongraphic alphabet''' which used symbols to represent words and ideas. It was only rarely used as Ee utilized their innate [[Ee mental power|mental powers]] to communicate [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]].<ref name="POTG">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref>
